uiBuilder.label: Swagger UI
uiBuilder.description: Render OpenAPI documentation with Swagger UI

properties.name: title
properties.label: Accessible title
properties.description: Label announced for the API documentation application region.

properties.name: definition
properties.label: OpenAPI definition
properties.description: Inline OpenAPI JSON or YAML document. Takes precedence over Definition URL.

properties.name: definitionUrl
properties.label: Definition URL
properties.description: URL of an OpenAPI JSON or YAML document. The resource must be reachable by the browser.

properties.name: height
properties.label: Height
properties.description: CSS height of the documentation area, for example 720px or 100%.

properties.name: deepLinking
properties.label: Enable deep linking
properties.description: Updates the URL fragment as users navigate API operations.

properties.name: docExpansion
properties.label: Operation expansion
properties.description: Initial expansion level for tags and operations.

properties.name: filter
properties.label: Enable filter
properties.description: Show a filter field for operations and tags.

properties.name: persistAuthorization
properties.label: Persist authorization
properties.description: Keep entered authorization values in browser storage.

properties.name: tryItOutEnabled
properties.label: Enable Try it out
properties.description: Allow users to prepare and send API requests. API authentication, CORS, and ACLs still apply.
